title: Annual Report 2023
why: Q1 and Q2: reports 19,496 FOI requests nationally in 2023, 19,391 reported by 53 MDAs, and 6 complaints (5 resolved, 1 pending).

title: RAIC Fines Corporate Affairs Commission NLe80,000 for Non-Compliance
why: Q2: dated RAIC penalty of NLe80,000 on the Corporate Affairs Commission over a request of 18 June 2024 made under the 2013 Act.

title: RAIC Secures Legal Victory Over Bank of Sierra Leone in Landmark Freedom of Information Case
why: Q2: reports a High Court ruling upholding RAIC's enforcement authority and reducing, not quashing, its penalty on a request made under the Act.

title: RAIC Fines Freetown City Council Le 70,000 for Failing to Release Information
why: Q2: dated RAIC penalty of Le 70,000 on Freetown City Council for failing to release information under the Act.

title: RAIC Chair Calls for Collective Efforts to Advance Information Access and Integrity
why: Q1: RAIC statement that 15,000 information requests were recorded in 2024 and over 90% were processed and provided.
